purpose: Split QA for one immutable candidate artifact version into non-overlapping verifier slices claimable by distinct ordinary workers without creating a second scheduler or judge.

authority_boundary.dedupe_authority: Existing Guide successor semantic pin using scripts/discovery-dedup-lib.mjs.
authority_boundary.final_judgment: Existing Judge/source owner/promotion authority for the candidate.
authority_boundary.note: This matrix compiles verification slices only. It does not make CANDIDATE become VERIFIED/CURRENT/HUMAN_ACCEPTED/SERVED.

rules: artifact_version_ref MUST be immutable for the evidence being checked: source commit/blob, deployment/version id, or served-byte digest as appropriate.
target_scope MUST name the concrete file/route/API/feature scope rather than prose.
A new artifact_version_ref creates a new QA generation; old PASS results never silently carry forward.

target.replica_index: 0 unless an existing contract explicitly requires independent replication

dedupe.execution_claim: Normal portfolio PIN for the materialized verifier job.
dedupe.collision_rule: Same artifact version + slice + target scope + fixture revision + replica_index produces the same semantic fingerprint. CREATE_EXISTS means equivalent verifier work already exists; do not mint a renamed duplicate.
dedupe.new_version_rule: Changing artifact_version_ref intentionally changes semantic identity, allowing verification of the successor version.
dedupe.intentional_replication_rule: replica_index MAY differ only when replication.required_replicas > 1 was declared before claims. Accidental duplicate workers may not create replica_index values retroactively.

result_schema.truth_rule: Every executed_checks item must name observable evidence. Unexecuted checks are absent, never implied.

one_verifier_is_enough_when: Exactly one slice is applicable and its acceptance evidence is mechanically sufficient for the owned candidate claim.

The change is local, reversible, low blast radius, and does not claim served UI, publication, authority/security/privacy behavior, cross-component E2E behavior, or preservation of a known-good baseline outside that slice.
The existing source owner/Judge does not require independent replication.
n_parallel_verifiers_when: Two or more orthogonal dimensions are independently necessary to establish the candidate claim; materialize one job per applicable slice and let ordinary workers claim them independently.
A candidate spans source/contract/publication/served behavior/visual/E2E/regression/adversarial concerns that cannot be proven by one evidence class.
Independent reproduction is explicitly required for a high-risk, externally brittle, ambiguous, or previously falsified slice. Declare required_replicas before claims.
parallelism_policy.n_definition: N is the number of applicable slice instances after explicit replication expansion, not the number of idle workers available.
parallelism_policy.anti_pattern: Never launch N workers on the same default slice merely because capacity exists.

qa_state_mapping.rule: The matrix may recommend blocking/asynchronous timing but cannot promote state by itself.

slices.goal: Source/configuration structure is part of the candidate.
preconditions: artifact_identity is complete and artifact_version_ref is immutable for this slice
slice acceptance is grounded in the candidate/source-owner contract
required target/fixture refs exist
acceptance: Exact source/blob/commit ref inspected
Static invariants relevant to the changed scope checked
No claim about served bytes inferred from source alone

slices.goal: Behavioral/API/schema/CLI contract is changed or relied upon.
preconditions: artifact_identity is complete and artifact_version_ref is immutable for this slice
slice acceptance is grounded in the candidate/source-owner contract
required target/fixture refs exist
acceptance: Declared contract cases executed against the candidate
Expected outputs/errors/invariants compared
Failures retain exact case evidence

slices.goal: Candidate claims that specific bytes/version were published or deployed.
preconditions: artifact_identity is complete and artifact_version_ref is immutable for this slice
slice acceptance is grounded in the candidate/source-owner contract
required target/fixture refs exist
acceptance: Published/deployed target resolves
Observed bytes/version are cryptographically or immutably tied to artifact_version_ref
No source-only evidence is substituted for publication evidence

slices.goal: Candidate claims real browser interaction on a served UI.
preconditions: artifact_identity is complete and artifact_version_ref is immutable for this slice
slice acceptance is grounded in the candidate/source-owner contract
required target/fixture refs exist
acceptance: Real served route loaded in representative JS browser
Declared click/tap/input path executed
Observed state/effect recorded

slices.goal: Visual/layout/typography/image rendering is part of acceptance or can regress.
preconditions: artifact_identity is complete and artifact_version_ref is immutable for this slice
slice acceptance is grounded in the candidate/source-owner contract
required target/fixture refs exist
acceptance: Rendered target captured/inspected at declared viewport(s)
Visual acceptance/preservation reference compared when one exists
Visual findings classified separately from functional PASS

slices.goal: Acceptance crosses more than one component, persistence boundary, network hop, auth boundary, or page/runtime owner.
preconditions: artifact_identity is complete and artifact_version_ref is immutable for this slice
slice acceptance is grounded in the candidate/source-owner contract
required target/fixture refs exist
acceptance: End-to-end path starts from declared user/system entry
All required boundary crossings are exercised
Final observable effect is tied to the same artifact version/configuration

slices.goal: A known-good baseline, Golden, must-preserve behavior, or prior accepted capability can regress.
preconditions: artifact_identity is complete and artifact_version_ref is immutable for this slice
slice acceptance is grounded in the candidate/source-owner contract
required target/fixture refs exist
acceptance: Relevant baseline/Golden identified
Candidate compared on must-preserve behavior
Any capability loss is reported as REGRESSION unless explicitly authorized

slices.goal: Authority/security/privacy/data-loss/untrusted-input/recovery semantics or other high-blast-radius failure modes are in scope.
preconditions: artifact_identity is complete and artifact_version_ref is immutable for this slice
slice acceptance is grounded in the candidate/source-owner contract
required target/fixture refs exist
acceptance: At least one plausible misuse/failure path is exercised or bounded
Authority/privacy/security boundaries are not inferred from happy-path PASS
Any untestable high-risk branch returns CAPABILITY_BOUNDARY rather than PASS

must_preserve: Normal worker portfolio PIN remains execution authority.
Existing Guide/Judge/source owner remains aggregation and promotion authority.
Worker hot path gains no mandatory QA handshake.
Same semantic verifier work cannot be duplicated by renaming a job.
Candidate and known-good CURRENT may coexist while asynchronous QA runs when existing policy permits.
